title: the Marlowe Estate Rising Again
author: C. M. Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Nystrom, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
